import os,sys,json,hashlib,subprocess,pathlib,ssl,urllib.request,datetime
sys.path.insert(0,"deploy")
import site_config as site
def ctl(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["systemctl","--user",*args],text=True).strip()
def identities():
    return {u:ctl("show",u,"-p","MainPID","-p","ActiveState","-p","NRestarts") for u in [site.UNIT,"q38-server.service"]}
root=pathlib.Path(ctl("show",site.UNIT,"-p","WorkingDirectory","--value"))
assert root.resolve()==site.DEPLOY_ROOT.resolve(),str(root)
target=root/"web/chat.js"
old=target.read_bytes()
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert sha(old)=="863d5346ac320cbc11153eadb2a9352dc97d7404e298c213a8c7cb982e95be10","Live asset changed; refusing overwrite"
new=pathlib.Path("web/chat.js").read_bytes()
before=identities()
assert all("ActiveState=active" in v for v in before.values()),before
backup=pathlib.Path("rollback/chat.js")
backup.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with backup.open("xb") as out: out.write(old)
temp=target.with_name("chat.js.voice-audio.tmp")
assert not temp.exists(),str(temp)
def replace(data):
    with temp.open("xb") as out: out.write(data)
    temp.chmod(target.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
    os.replace(temp,target)
try:
    replace(new)
    with urllib.request.urlopen("https://127.0.0.1:8094/chat.js",context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(site.CERT)),timeout=20) as response:
        served=response.read()
    assert served==new,"HTTPS serves different bytes"
    after=identities()
    assert before==after,{"before":before,"after":after}
except BaseException:
    replace(old)
    raise
report={"time":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"target":str(target),"old_sha256":sha(old),"new_sha256":sha(new),"backup":str(backup.resolve()),"https_matches":True,"service_identities_unchanged":after,"deployment_kind":"atomic static asset update; no service restart"}
pathlib.Path("evidence/browser-audio-deployment.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
